title: Subscribe to this box!
text: For real, people. If you like tea at all, this subscription box is amazing. Each month they have a really interesting variety of blends, and each bag tells you how much to use, how long to steep it for, whether it's high-med-low-no caffeine, and I've never tasted a loser. Seriously, I've been getting this for 3 or 4 months now, and every time it's like Christmas because I know I'm going to love what they have. Know that it is loose leaf tea, so if you don't already have one, you'll want to procure a roomy tea ball to hold the tea while it steeps in your mug. I've been very glad I subscribed to this box and I've recommended it to others. Buy this tea!
label: positive
